test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Global Hunger Index 2022, which neighbouring country is only behind India with a rank of 109 out of 121 countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Afghanistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Global Hunger Index:-**

 
 
• **GHI is a tool designed to comprehensively measure and track hunger at the global, regional, and country levels. **
 
• **It is jointly published by Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe, two international humanitarian organizations. **
 
• The GHI 2022 report found that the world's GHI score remained virtually unchanged from 2014 to 2022, at 18.2.
 
• This indicates that progress in reducing hunger has been slow and uneven.
 
• The report also found that the number of undernourished people in the world has increased in recent years, to an estimated 828 million in 2021.
 
• **Based on the Global Hunger Index (GHI) 2022, Afghanistan is the only neighboring country ranked behind India with a rank of 109 out of 121 countries. India's GHI ranking is 107, indicating a "serious" level of hunger.**
